name: speedread
description: Token-efficient code reading for AI coding agents: symbol-aware, budgeted, diff-aware reads.
long_description: speedread gives the agent the part of a codebase a question needs, within a token budget: the function around each search hit, a large file's skeleton, a symbol's callers and implementations, or only what changed since the last read. Read-only by construction: paths must lie inside the folder you choose. Built for macOS on Apple Silicon.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Budgeted repository overview, with each file's top-level definitions on request.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Files, ranges, symbols, sections and globs in one call under one token budget; only what changed on a re-read.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Text search with each hit grouped under its enclosing function or class.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Callers, callees, references and implementations of a symbol, up to three levels deep.

workspace.title: Code folder
workspace.description: The folder speedread may read: one project, or a parent folder such as ~/code. Reads outside it are refused.
